messages:
anika: Quick heads-up — after the kernel-selector change merged in cc3f9b we see a tail-latency regression on small batches (<8) when the fused-attn variant wins. Rough repro attached below.

anika: Repro summary:
```
bench: attn_compare --model=gpt-like --batch=4 --seq=512 --warmup=20 --iter=200
commit: cc3f9b (prefer fused variants in selector)
attn_fused_v2: p50=9.2ms p95=22.1ms p99=45.3ms
flash_paged_alt: p50=8.7ms p95=17.8ms p99=30.2ms
L2 bw (avg): fused=420GB/s (bursty), flash_paged=300GB/s (steady)
SM occupancy: fused ~65% vs flash_paged ~80%
notes: repeated L2 bandwidth spikes correlate with p99 outliers
```

anika: Suspect the fused kernel's pipeline causes L2 thrashing at these tile sizes + small batch aggregation; KV-cache behavior looks fine but we might be evicting hot lines during stage-swaps. @leo can you confirm if the selector now favors fused for seq<=512?

leo: Yup, selector change adds heuristic: if model_has_fused && batch <= 8 && seq <= 1024 -> prefer_fused true. I added it to avoid extra kernel hops for large seqs but didn't run small-batch tail checks. My bad.

leo: Quick diff:
```
- if (is_flash_variant) score += 10;
+ if (is_flash_variant) score += 8;
+ if (has_fused_paths && batch <= 8 && seq <= 1024) score += 12;  // cc3f9b
```

maya: Repro commands I ran: `KERNEL_HINT=prefer_flash_paged ./scripts/bench/attn_compare.sh --batch 4 --seq 512` — switching hint back to flash_paged drops p99 from ~45ms -> ~29ms. Worth trying quick config toggle as mitigation. :+1:

maya: Also, try increasing tile_k to reduce L2 working set: `export TILE_K=64` (default 32) — that reduced L2 burstiness in my nsight runs.

tom: Ran a CI micro-benchmark on a 80GB A100, 3 runs each, output below:
```
run1: fused p99=44.8ms dram_bw=85GB/s l2_hit=0.55
run2: fused p99=46.1ms dram_bw=82GB/s l2_hit=0.52
run3: flash p99=29.6ms dram_bw=68GB/s l2_hit=0.71
counters: L2_bw_peak spikes ~420GB/s at stage switch for fused
```

tom: Looks consistent. My quick hack was to reduce pipeline stages in fused (drop one reorder stage) and p99 improved ~12%. But that touched hot code; need safer config.

anika: Good data. Action items: 1) rollback selector heuristic for batch<=8 (leo), 2) add a config flag to prefer_flash_paged at runtime with env override (maya), 3) add a micro-benchmark for small-batch p99 in CI (tom + ci-bot). I'll file a short PR for the selector rollback.

leo: I can open PR to revert the heuristic and add a small-batch canary test. Will include the nsight counter snapshot and the git bisect notes.

ci-bot: benchmark-run 1901234567-aux finished — artifacts: https://ci.redwood/attn/1901234567 (perf logs, nsight traces).

anika: Thanks. If we can't fully revert quickly, we should at least gate the fused preference behind an opt-in flag until we tune tiling/pipeline to avoid L2 thrash.

maya: For longer-term: look into KV-cache affinity (pin hot KV pages to avoid eviction during stage swaps) and adding a tiny soft-prefetch before stage boundary. Might get latency benefits w/o kernel changes.

tom: Agreed — I'll prototype a prefetch patch and run it against the same bench.

anika: Cool. Keeping this thread for follow-ups — post PR links here. :sparkles:
